checks.description: timestamps non-decreasing
checks.rationale: required for sequential SLAM

checks.description: malformed records skipped
checks.rationale: any skipped record is data loss

checks.description: fraction of scans with <60 points
checks.rationale: short fragments (log start) are skipped by the matcher; must be rare

checks.description: longest timestamp gap (s)
checks.rationale: gaps >1 s would break constant-velocity prediction; none expected at 13 Hz

checks.description: sensor extrinsics / angle zero from a calibration file
checks.rationale: no calibration file supplied; angle sign validated against model (mirrored map fails), zero direction absorbed in registration yaw

checks.description: IMU / odometry available for fusion
checks.rationale: none in the log (keys t0,t1,a,r); trajectory is LiDAR + model only

checks.description: median scan-to-submap inlier fraction (<=15 cm)
checks.rationale: healthy indoor matching; low values indicate poor overlap

checks.description: fraction of scans needing correlative recovery
checks.rationale: recovery = tracking nearly lost

checks.description: median scan-matching rms (m)
checks.rationale: about 2x the expected range noise of a low-cost 2D LiDAR (unknown model; provisional)

checks.description: max keyframe-to-keyframe jump after optimisation / odometry (m)
checks.rationale: keyframes are <=0.3 m apart; a larger jump = trajectory discontinuity

checks.description: p95 change of relative keyframe motion odometry -> optimised (m)
checks.rationale: optimisation should correct drift without distorting local geometry

checks.description: p95 change of relative keyframe yaw odometry -> optimised (deg)
checks.rationale: same, for rotation

checks.description: verified LiDAR-only loop closures kept
checks.rationale: at least some independent LiDAR-only revisits confirm consistency

checks.description: anchoring rounds converged: last-round median inlier fraction
checks.rationale: chunks fit the model section at the end of optimisation

checks.description: pose-graph solver status 'converged' (scipy status>0)
checks.rationale: status 0 = max evaluations reached; cost is stable across rounds but not formally converged

checks.description: first estimated pose offset from sphere (m)
checks.rationale: sphere radius is 0.29 m; sphere centre is only an approximate start marker

checks.description: sphere-consistent start is the top-ranked unconstrained global fit
checks.rationale: global localisation of the first 12 keyframes without any positional prior

checks.description: margin of top candidate over runner-up (score)
checks.rationale: repeated rooms make start localisation ambiguous; small margin means the sphere is what disambiguates

checks.description: fraction of map points within 10 cm of model section
checks.rationale: remaining share is furniture/open doors/as-built differences; model-dependent (anchored)

checks.description: median distance map point -> model (m)
checks.rationale: sub-3 cm needs both a good trajectory and an accurate model

checks.description: LiDAR-only map: fraction within 10 cm after best rigid fit
checks.rationale: diagnostic of residual SLAM drift without anchoring (not a pass/fail quantity)

checks.description: |estimated scale - 1| (similarity fit of map to model)
checks.rationale: model is metric, LiDAR is metric; scale must be consistent. estimated scale=1.00013

checks.description: median perpendicular offset LiDAR face -> nearest parallel model wall face (m)
checks.rationale: design vs as-built + registration; model-dependent

checks.description: p90 perpendicular offset LiDAR face -> model (m)
checks.rationale: tail dominated by as-built differences and angled walls

checks.description: median |measured room dimension - nominal label size| (m), observed rooms
checks.rationale: label sizes are design intent; rooms bounded partly by model-derived edges, door lines and furniture bias the min-rectangle; n=53 rooms

checks.description: room boundary consistency: mean rectangularity (area / min-rect area), observed rooms
checks.rationale: most rooms are near-rectangular; very low values flag boundary leaks

checks.description: median face uncertainty sigma (m)
checks.rationale: sigma = sqrt((rms/sqrt(n_scans))^2 + sigma_registration^2)

checks.description: fraction of model wall length supported by LiDAR (8 cm)
checks.rationale: floor coverage; unsupported wall is labelled model-derived in the plan

checks.description: overlapping duplicate wall faces after merge
checks.rationale: repeated estimates of the same wall must be merged

checks.description: comparison with surveyed (as-built) reference dimensions
checks.rationale: no total-station / tape reference dimensions were supplied; only model design dimensions are available

checks.description: all original objects present with unchanged world matrices in output .blend
checks.rationale: reopened output and compared against the original file

checks.description: required collections exist in reopened output .blend
checks.rationale: collections found: ['01_Slab', '02_Walls_columns', '02_Walls_w100', '02_Walls_w150', '02_Walls_w175', '02_Walls_w230', '02_Walls_w300', '02_Walls_wo', '03_Doors', '04_Windows', '05_Railings', '06_Stairs']...

checks.rationale: 295877 points reloaded

checks.rationale: 773 entities

checks.rationale: ok
